items.source:
pub fn permitted(
    policy: &crate::model_contract::ModelAccessPolicy,
    provider: SubscriptionProvider,
    native: &str,
) -> bool {
    policy.permits(native)
        || (provider == SubscriptionProvider::Gemini
            && native
                .strip_prefix("models/")
                .is_some_and(|id| policy.permits(id)))
}
